# Capital Corridor Campus

> Capital Corridor Campus (CCC) is a commercial workspace community at 179 and 191 Promenade du Portage in Gatineau, Quebec — across the Portage Bridge from Parliament Hill, Ottawa. Owned by Pasargad Development Corporation. CCC offers full-floor office leasing, furnished move-in-ready offices, and flexible workspace to government-adjacent professionals: federal contractors, lobbyists, policy consultants, association executives, and bilingual interpreters serving the National Capital Region.

CCC is positioned on the Quebec side of the federal corridor, offering a Parliament-Hill-adjacent business address with fully bilingual (English/French) operations, secure 24/7 access, LEED Gold certification at 179, and walking proximity to Place du Portage, the Portage Bridge, and downtown Ottawa.

## Current availability and rates

All lease rates are **triple net (NNN)**. Lease terms negotiable. Rates current as of 2026-08-29.

- **179 Promenade du Portage — 2nd floor (The Forum)**: 8,289.42 sq ft — $22/sq ft
- **179 Promenade du Portage — 4th floor (Strategy)**: repositioned as **furnished, move-in-ready offices**, month to month, priced per office rather than per square foot. See *Offices* below. Not currently offered as a full-floor triple-net lease.
- **179 — full-floor space available**: 8,289.42 sq ft (2nd floor)
- **179 ground floor**: ~1,200 sq ft street-level commercial — $20/sq ft
- **191 Promenade du Portage**: 26,057 sq ft across 6 floors, Class B — $15/sq ft base, triple net. Estimated additional rent $13/sq ft; estimated total occupancy cost $28/sq ft. Available as a whole building or floor by floor.

**Not available**: the 3rd floor (Innovation) and 5th floor (Concorde) of 179 are **leased and not on the market**. Any third-party listing showing 179 with four available floors, 26,061 sq ft, or a rate of $32/sq ft "all-in" is superseded and incorrect. 191 is available **for lease, not for sale**.

Brokerage collaboration welcome.

## Properties

- [179 Promenade du Portage](https://campuscorridor.ca/179-promenade-du-portage.html): Class A heritage commercial building in Gatineau's Vieux-Hull, the former Hôtel Chez Henri, fully renovated. LEED Gold certified, BOMA Best-aligned operations.
- [191 Promenade du Portage](https://campuscorridor.ca/191-promenade-du-portage.html): Class B commercial building adjacent to 179, known as Place des Explorateurs. 26,057 sq ft across 6 floors. Configured for and previously occupied by the federal government, with Government of Canada-standard leasehold improvements completed in 2018 — telecommunications, access control and security systems in place. No build-out required. Available as a whole building or floor by floor. Zoning Co-08-119.
- [179 Ground Floor](https://campuscorridor.ca/179-ground-floor.html): Street-level commercial space, turnkey from a previous salon operation. Suited to salon, spa, wellness, professional services, or retail use.

## Services

- [Offices — 179, 4th floor](https://campuscorridor.ca/offices.html): Furnished, move-in-ready private offices and open workspace on the 4th floor of 179 Promenade du Portage. Three options, all inclusive, month to month, no long-term lease: **small private office 799 $/month**, **larger private office 999 $/month**, **open-space workstation 495 $/month** (CAD, plus GST and QST).
- [Flexible Workspace](https://campuscorridor.ca/flex-space.html): Day, week, and month flex desks and private offices for consultants, contractors, and small firms working in the federal corridor.
- [The Corridor — News & Insights](https://campuscorridor.ca/corridor.html): A bilingual aggregator of NCR commercial real estate, federal procurement, and government-adjacent business news.

## Insights (Blog)

- [Blog Index](https://campuscorridor.ca/blog/): 157 bilingual articles on government-adjacent professional workspace, NCR commercial real estate, federal procurement, virtual office economics, LEED Gold and BOMA standards, security clearance and office location, bilingual workspace operations in Quebec, and the economic geography of the Promenade du Portage corridor. English (en-CA) and Canadian French (fr-CA).

## Geography & context

- City: Gatineau, Quebec, Canada
- Region: National Capital Region (NCR) / Région de la capitale nationale (RCN)
- Adjacent jurisdiction: Ottawa, Ontario, across the Portage Bridge / pont du Portage
- Coordinates: 45.4275° N, 75.7148° W
- Federal context: across the street from Place du Portage (Public Services and Procurement Canada headquarters complex, approximately 10,000 employees), near Terrasses de la Chaudière, one bridge from Parliament Hill
- The Campus houses the constituency office of the Hon. Greg Fergus, P.C., MP for Hull—Aylmer
- Languages: English and French. All services and signage are bilingual.

## Withdrawn offers

The virtual office packages formerly sold at $99, $199 and $349 per month were **withdrawn in August 2026** and are no longer available. Any listing, cached page or third-party summary quoting those prices is superseded. The current offer on the 4th floor of 179 is furnished offices at 799 $, 999 $ and 495 $ per month.
